title: Paradigm Power Cup
label: MALL TOURNAMENT
description: Two days of BEYBLADE X competition, with six sessions and two final knockout stages.
details: 389 registered players were reported for this event. This is a registration figure, not a mall footfall or spectator count.

title: BEYBLADE X at AEON
label: MALL TOURNAMENT
description: A competitive stage for the Beyblade community at AEON Mall Bukit Tinggi.
details: Gaming Genius delivered tournament operations, multi-camera live production and spectator screens.

title: Centro Mall Battles
label: MALL TOURNAMENT
description: Bringing the BEYBLADE X community together at Centro Mall.
details: Two tournament sessions were reported, with capacity for up to 64 players per session. Capacity is not presented as actual attendance. Exact event dates and final results will be added to the archive.

title: Little Racers Challenge II
label: JUNIOR ESPORTS
description: The second chapter of our children's racing competition. Real matches, player stories and a stage for young racers.
details: Advertised competition dates: 23–24 and 30–31 May 2026. The project wrapped up in June, as recalled by the organiser. Final results and event photographs are awaiting archive upload.

title: Little Racers Challenge I
label: WHERE IT STARTED
description: Our first Little Racers Challenge: a competitive experience built around children, families and the excitement of racing.
details: The first edition laid the foundation for the Little Racers series. Final results and event photographs will be added to this archive.

title: Weekly Battle Nights
label: COMMUNITY SESSIONS
description: Regular battles, familiar faces and room for new players to find their rhythm.
details: Past weekly tournaments belong in the GG archive. Individual dates and verified results are being collected. Check with GG for the next confirmed session; this page does not advertise a fixed weekly schedule.

title: TCG & Board Game Experiences
label: DISCOVER & PLAY
description: Community experiences beyond the arena, including Pokémon TCG and board games.
details: This is a collection of GG activities, rather than a single tournament. Individual dates, formats and photographs are awaiting organiser confirmation.

title: Elmina Cup
label: ON THE HORIZON
description: The next proposed chapter for GG's Beyblade community.
details: Proposed dates and venue only. Final programme, registration and any official tournament designation remain subject to confirmation. No registration is open through this website.
